subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should rapid LINE media batching be implemented as LINE plugin-owned imageSet-first behavior with an optional heuristic fallback, as a broader shared channel/media batching contract, or intentionally left unsupported for channels without reliable grouping metadata?
rationale: The remaining request adds delayed webhook behavior and likely new config for a channel whose SDK now has partial native grouping metadata, so automation should not choose the default, fallback heuristic, or owner boundary.

options.title: LINE imageSet-first batching
options.body: Implement LINE-owned batching keyed by account, conversation, sender, and imageSet id when present, with any time-proximity fallback disabled or narrowly opt-in.

options.title: Shared channel contract
options.body: Design a media-aware channel/plugin SDK contract first, accepting broader compatibility and architecture review before changing LINE behavior.

options.title: Keep unsupported
options.body: Keep Telegram album buffering and text-only inbound debounce as the supported behavior, and document that LINE media without usable grouping dispatches as separate turns.

recommendation.title: LINE imageSet-first batching
recommendation.body: Implement LINE-owned batching keyed by account, conversation, sender, and imageSet id when present, with any time-proximity fallback disabled or narrowly opt-in.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across LINE config/media handling and repository config-surface policy for this boundary choice.
